election_info.notes: Official Wayne County precinct canvass (Partisan Offices by Precinct; Judicial, City, School Races & Proposals). Precinct totals; write-ins, over and under votes omitted. Precinct 42 combines portions 42D and 42W. Unopposed races (Treasurer, County Commissioner 13th District), judicial races, straight-party ticket, and the Westwood school board (42W only) omitted. unit_maps map each 2024 precinct to the 2026 precincts and to the combined units used by the 2025 data.
